 Peel test devices 
 Peel test devices
Peel test devices, are used to determine peel forces and the coefficient of sliding friction on films and textiles and for adhesion testing. They are available in different trigger angles.
Peel test device 90° according to DIN 53494
90° peel tests on coated materials, e.g. for testing EC cards
Peeling test device with movable peel-off table
Various trigger angles: 45°, 90° and 180°
